about.text: Results-driven Data Engineer, expert in designing scalable data acquisition architectures and distributed processing pipelines. Specialist in complex web automation, anti-detection engineering and ETL/ELT orchestration. Proven mastery of Medallion (Lakehouse) architectures and of integrating local AI/NLP models for data enrichment. Demonstrated ability to deploy robust containerized solutions that turn raw, unstructured data into strategic intelligence.

projects.title: Data Lakehouse & Automated Sending of AI-Generated Emails
projects.description: End-to-end system architecture for data ingestion, and implementation of a complete automated email sending system with AI-generated content and distributed orchestration.
projects.imageAlt: Data Lakehouse & Automated Sending of AI-Generated Emails
tasks: Designed a multi-stage ingestion pipeline to extract unstructured data (Gmail/RSS) into a Delta Lake storage layer.
Implemented distributed NLP preprocessing (lemmatization and NER) and LLM content generation (text, HTML), then updated the enriched data.
Engineered a large-scale sending system using Celery and Playwright, simulating human behavior to bypass automated filters.
Deployed monitoring tasks to ensure pipeline health, delivery reliability and error handling under Docker.

projects.title: ML-Based Web Form Detection for Email Warm-up
projects.description: Developed a website analysis system that automatically identifies the forms useful for email warm-up (e.g. newsletter, forgotten password, contact).
projects.imageAlt: ML-Based Web Form Detection for Email Warm-up
tasks: Automated extraction of HTML forms and CSS selectors to build a proprietary dataset of interactions.
Trained a supervised Machine Learning model (TF-IDF + Multinomial Naive Bayes) to accurately classify form types.
Used MLflow for experiment tracking and model versioning, ensuring reproducible results.
Exposed predictions through a REST API for smooth integration with downstream automation tools.

projects.title: Distributed Multi-Source Data Aggregation Pipeline
projects.description: Designed a high-throughput ETL pipeline to aggregate and validate data from MongoDB, Elasticsearch and flat files.
tasks: Optimized the insertion logic for MongoDB and Elasticsearch to handle large-scale aggregation of unique records.
Implemented parallel processing for efficient data extraction and consolidated reporting.
Developed automated cleaning and validation layers to guarantee data quality before consumption.

projects.title: Network-Level Data Interception & Analysis
projects.description: Engineered a sophisticated data collection system using MitmProxy to intercept and analyze encrypted network traffic.
tasks: Configured and deployed MitmProxy on Raspberry Pi and Docker environments for transparent traffic interception.
Developed custom Python add-ons to parse HTTP/S flows in real time and extract granular social and advertising metrics.
Optimized data persistence with a two-layer strategy: Redis for fast ingestion and PostgreSQL for relational analysis.
Collaborated on the architectural design to ensure system scalability and data integrity.

projects.title: Social Intelligence Desktop Application
projects.description: Developed a cross-platform desktop application for real-time social data extraction and manual annotation.
tasks: Integrated Selenium with a Kivy graphical interface to allow real-time monitoring of automated scrolling and capture.
Built manual annotation features for sentiment analysis, sector classification and geographic tagging.
Implemented a local database verification layer to avoid duplicates and keep the dataset clean.

projects.title: Data Modernization & Migration (RDBMS to NoSQL)
projects.description: Led a MySQL to MongoDB migration project to improve the scalability of an enterprise GPS tracking system.
tasks: Analyzed the existing relational schemas to design an optimized NoSQL document model.
Performed the ETL on historical CSV archives, ensuring data consistency and integrity during the transition.
Integrated the new data layer into the main application and generated validation reports.
